backgrounds.name: Demigod Scion
backgrounds.description: Mortal child of an Olympian deity, carrying heavenly lineage and the heavy burden of heroic destiny. Temples treat you with reverent awe or fearful suspicion.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +1 to all divine favor and piety gains; recognized by priests of your patron deity.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks divine lineage dialogue options when speaking with priests, seers, and monsters.

backgrounds.name: Oracle or Seer
backgrounds.description: Touched by Apollo or the Chthonic Muses, experiencing fragmented prophecies through sacred smoke, trances, and midnight dreams.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 Passive Perception; sense hidden dangers and impending ambushes on mountain trails.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks prophetic insight dialogue options that deduce hidden intentions of strangers.

backgrounds.name: Temple Acolyte
backgrounds.description: Raised within sanctuary precincts, maintaining eternal hearth fires, offering barley cakes, and compounding consecrated healing dittany.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Healing salves and draughts restore 20% more health; sacred offerings cost no drachmae.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks liturgical knowledge when negotiating with temple elders and hierophants.

backgrounds.name: Cursed Mortal
backgrounds.description: You or your ancestral bloodline committed hubris against a deity, bearing an indelible supernatural mark that invites hardship and test.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 bonus on all saving throws against poison, necrotic blights, and curses.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks desperate defiance choices when confronted by monstrous beings and tyrants.

backgrounds.name: Nymph-Raised Foundling
backgrounds.description: Abandoned in infancy upon mountain crags and fostered by woodland dryads and mountain satyrs. You are far more at home beneath wild pines than within city walls.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Travel stamina cost reduced by 15% across rough wilderness and dense groves.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks woodland empathy when encountering centaurs, satyrs, and wild beasts.

backgrounds.name: Hoplite Veteran
backgrounds.description: Former citizen-soldier who endured blood and dust in the bronze-locked ranks of the phalanx. You value loyalty, iron discipline, and shield brothers.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +1 Armor Class when fighting alongside companions or guards; +2 morale check bonus.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks martial camaraderie dialogue with city watch captains and veterans.

backgrounds.name: Pankration Champion
backgrounds.description: Celebrated athlete crowned with sacred wild celery or olive wreaths at the Panhellenic Games for brutal wrestling and unarmed triumphs.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Unarmed strikes deal +2 bonus damage; athletic feats of strength roll with advantage.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Recognized in major poleis, granting discounts at taverns and boasting privileges.

backgrounds.name: Monster Hunter
backgrounds.description: Wayfaring slayer who stalks chimeras, harpies, and ferocious boars for bounty silver, studying creature behavior, tracks, and anatomies.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Harvesting slain monsters yields 50% more rare crafting components and pelts.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks anatomical vulnerability options during monster encounters.

backgrounds.name: Myrmidon or Royal Guard
backgrounds.description: Sworn protector of a legendary basileus or warlord, seasoned in palace intrigue, personal duels, and uncompromising military defense.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 bonus on initiative rolls; immunity to being disarmed in combat.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks high-status noble protocol when speaking with magistrates and kings.

backgrounds.name: Argonaut or Sailor
backgrounds.description: Hardened oarsman who sailed uncharted waters, weathered sirens' chants, clashing rocks, and Poseidon's unpredictable tempests.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Immunity to drowning penalties; sea voyages and ferry travel cost 30% less silver.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks tall maritime tales and foreign port contacts in coastal settlements.

backgrounds.name: Philosopher or Sophist
backgrounds.description: Educated in the Athenian Lyceum or Ionian schools in rhetoric, logic, ethics, astronomy, and the fundamental elements of nature.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Solving inscriptions and puzzles awards +25 additional Kleos experience.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks logical rebuttal dialogue options that confuse hostile rhetoricians.

backgrounds.name: Artisan of the Forge
backgrounds.description: Apprenticed to Hephaestus-blessed bronzesmiths and masons, capable of evaluating metal purity, balancing blades, and repairing battered armor.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Crafted weapons and armor gain a permanent +5% durability and value bonus.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks material appraisal choices with merchants, identifying counterfeit goods.

backgrounds.name: Exiled Noble
backgrounds.description: Cast out from your ancestral acropolis following a blood feud or palace coup. Though stripped of lands, you retain courtly manners and old connections.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Start with an ancestral signet ring valued at 35 silver drachmae; +1 Charisma.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks diplomatic recognition from aristocrats and foreign dignitaries.

backgrounds.name: Underworld Escapee
backgrounds.description: You crossed the black waters of the Styx and witnessed the Asphodel Meadows before escaping back through an ancient chthonic fissure.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Cold and necrotic damage suffered is reduced by 3 points; immune to ghost terror.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks chilling chthonic dialogue options when conversing with undead or necromancers.

backgrounds.name: Cultist of the Mysteries
backgrounds.description: Initiated into the nocturnal rites of the Kabeiroi or Eleusis, holding oaths of sacred silence regarding life, death, and the soul's rebirth.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 bonus on all skill checks conducted in darkness, caves, or subterranean tombs.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks secret handshakes and coded phrases to recognize fellow initiates.

backgrounds.name: Brigand of the Crags
backgrounds.description: Surviving in the windswept limestone ravines between poleis, skilled in ambush tactics, concealed paths, mountain caves, and raiding caravans.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: +2 bonus on pickpocketing and ambush rolls; locate mountain springs without maps.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Unlocks underworld criminal cant when interacting with bandits and smugglers.
